verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is Adyen-generated reports for the platform's own bookkeeping and reconciliation. Nothing shows seller-facing, self-serve per-seller statements, payout reconciliation views, or exports a seller's bookkeeper could use without going through the platform operator. Operator-level reporting is an adjacent capability, not the embedded seller self-serve experience the story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops user, sellers can self-serve their money questions — per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, and exports that let their bookkeeper close the month without contacting me
